rule: Lowercase; replace & with "and"; µ→u; β→beta; strip punctuation to spaces; collapse spaces.
Remove specimen words before matching: serum, sr, s, plasma, whole blood, edta, fluoride, fluoride plasma, heparin, citrate — but keep "urine" and "stool" (they change the parameter).

Remove method words: calculated, calc, direct (except LDL/bilirubin — keep, it is part of the name), enzymatic, kinetic, colorimetric, clia, eclia, cmia, elfa, hplc, ise, indirect ise, immunoturbidimetric, turbidimetric, electrical impedance, flow cytometry, microscopy, photometry, spectrophotometry. Store the removed method in observation.method.
Remove bracketed abbreviations only if the remaining text matches; otherwise try the bracket content alone, e.g. "Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT)" → try full, then "ALT".
Exact match on normalised alias first; then match with specimen/method words removed; then fuzzy (edit distance ≤ 2 on names ≥ 6 chars) → always send fuzzy matches to review.
Use the section heading (panel alias) to disambiguate: CBC, Lipid, Urine routine, etc. Urine-section rows only match urine parameters.
Use the printed unit to disambiguate (see Ambiguities) and to pick conversions; unknown unit → review.
Never auto-merge different tests that share a word: 25-OH vs 1,25 vitamin D, total vs free T3/T4, PSA total vs free, glucose fasting vs PP vs random vs OGTT.
